messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change only the person's top to match the reference garment images (front and back views). Preserve the garment's design, color, pattern, and fit as shown in the references. Leave the rest of the outfit and everything else in the video unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please go back to the video from before the first camera change was made, then use that video as the starting point for the following change: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change only the person's top to match the reference images. Leave the rest of the outfit and everything else in the video unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The person stands still, then walks forward away from the camera, and finally stops and turns their head to the left.","camera":"A static, medium-full shot from behind the subject at a slightly low angle.","clothing":"A white sleeveless tank top with a colorful graphic on the back, light blue shorts with white trim, and red sneakers.","hair_color":"Black.","hairstyle":"Short, dark hair.","identity":"A slim, dark-skinned person with a muscular build, seen from behind.","scene":"A futuristic, open-air plaza with a wet, reflective concrete floor, surrounded by modern buildings with glowing blue and pink lights."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The original pink/yellow tie-dye tank top was replaced with a white tank top. In the output, the visible back of the top shows a colorful graphic, whereas the reference back view is plain; the front graphic is not visible because the character is seen from behind.
arguments.requested_change: Change only the person's top to match the reference garment: a white sleeveless tank top with a pink sunset/palm-tree "LA" graphic on the front and a plain back, preserving design, color, pattern, and fit while leaving the rest of the outfit and scene unchanged.
uncertain: Whether the front of the top matches the reference 'LA' graphic, since the character remains facing away from the camera.
unexpected_changes: The back of the new top displays a graphic, while the reference back view is plain white.
